settings.heading: Good records for good times.

settings.intro: From first turntable to last grail — we've got you.

blocks.title: New & used vinyl
blocks.text: Soul, jazz, funk, rock, Dutch pressings and fresh new releases every Friday.

blocks.title: We buy records
blocks.text: Bring your collection — fair cash offers on the spot.

blocks.title: Turntable repair
blocks.text: Cartridges, belts, servicing and full restorations.

blocks.title: Listening bar
blocks.text: Coffee by day, natural wine by night, records always.

settings.heading: Three generations of crate diggers.
settings.text: Grandpa Joop opened the shop with a box of soul 45s and a borrowed van. We've moved twice, survived the CD era, and we're still here — still playing records out loud and still arguing about the best Stevie Wonder album.

blocks.quote: Lost a whole afternoon in the jazz section and left with a smile and a stack of Blue Notes.
blocks.author: Ruben

blocks.quote: They brought my dad's old Technics back to life. Sounds better than new.
blocks.author: Noa

blocks.quote: Thursday nights here are the best kept secret in town.
blocks.author: Dex

settings.heading: Looking for something special?
settings.text: Tell us what's on your wantlist and we'll call when it comes in.
